en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Abdul Jabbar, from Ibn Fazzal, from Hammad Bin Usman, from Abdul A’ala Bin Ayn who said,

‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘I<sup>asws</sup> born from (the children of) Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>, and I<sup>asws</sup> know the Book of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>; and in it is the beginning of the creation, and what is going to happen up to the Day of Judgment, and therein is the news of the sky and news of the earth, and news of the Paradise, and news of the Fire, and news of what was, and news of what is to happen. I<sup>asws</sup> know all that just as I look at my<sup>asws</sup> own palm.
Allah<sup>azwj</sup> is Saying ‘Therein is an explanation of everything”’.
